contracts.protected_operation: Outbound HTTP requests against user-supplied URLs carried in state.youtube_links, state.webpage_links, and state.research_paper_links — both the validation-time reachability probe (requests.head, input_validation.py:40) and downstream crew fetches consuming the sanitized lists.

contracts.protection_obligation: SSRF private-IP rejection for outbound fetching of flow-supplied URLs: every URL in youtube_links, webpage_links, and research_paper_links must have its hostname resolved and be rejected if it maps into a private/internal range before any fetch proceeds, and the run must abort if no source of any kind survives validation.
scope_limits: The reachability probe follows redirects (allow_redirects=True, input_validation.py:40); the supplied source shows no re-validation of redirect targets against _is_private_ip.

_is_private_ip returns False on any exception, including DNS resolution failure (security.py:30-31); unresolvable hostnames are not rejected as private and are only dropped later if requests.head raises ConnectionError/Timeout (input_validation.py:41-48).

contracts.protection_obligation: Local document reads must be confined to DOCUMENT_INPUT_DIR: every path in document_paths must resolve inside the configured directory, exist, and not exceed MAX_FILE_BYTES before the sanitized list is admitted to flow state and consumed downstream; the run aborts if no source of any kind survives validation.
